architecture.mechanism: The spark plug functions as a sensor whose high-voltage waveform signature (arc duration, breakdown/flashover voltage) reveals spark gap wear and combustion system state, enabling real-time condition monitoring and correct diagnostic decisions.
architecture.intervention: During Nissan recall service, perform non-contact high-voltage measurement at each cylinder's spark plug to compare arc duration and breakdown voltage across cylinders and against temperature-corrected baselines; replace plugs whose signatures indicate excessive gap wear, per the recall procedure.
architecture.expected_effect: Worn or degraded spark plugs are identified and replaced before misfire/stall events occur, restoring consistent ignition and eliminating engine-malfunction stalls while the recall procedure's compliance steps are preserved.
architecture.falsification_test: Record high-voltage waveforms for all cylinders before and after recall-mandated spark plug replacement; if breakdown voltage does not decrease and arc duration does not lengthen on worn-gap cylinders post-replacement, the spark-plug-as-sensor wear mechanism is falsified as the stall cause.
